notes.title: Update 0.9.10
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes :[/h1]
- The opening sound of the chests was heard twice
- The Slimes did not chase the player if he hit them first
- The scores were not displayed correctly

[h1]Changes :[/h1]
- Added animations for the hands
- Chests and grids no longer open instantly
- Added an eye icon on the Slimes to indicate that they are chasing the player
- The player loses stamina if he runs
- The player can hit in the void but will lose endurance
